episodeTitle.en: Why AI is going vertical (again) | Dianne Penn (Anthropic)
episodeTitle.zh: 为什么 AI 又开始向垂直领域深入？｜Anthropic 的 Dianne Penn

guestBioOfficial.zh: Dianne Penn 于 2023 年成为 Anthropic 首位技术产品经理，录制时负责 AI 研究与 Labs 的产品工作。她参与了多代 Claude 模型和 Claude Code 等产品的交付，工作常在模型研究、真实任务与产品评测之间往返。
guestBioOfficial.en: Anthropic’s first technical PM, Dianne Penn joined in 2023 and leads product for AI Research and Labs. She has worked on successive Claude models and on products including Claude Code, connecting research with concrete user tasks.

title.en: Why AI is going vertical (again) | Dianne Penn (Anthropic)
title.zh: 为什么 AI 又开始向垂直领域深入？｜Anthropic 的 Dianne Penn

summary.zh: 给团队更多 token，究竟要换回什么？Dianne 用实验次数、失败样例和产品评测回答这个问题。她还谈到工作中的判断力与养育孩子的共通之处：即使工具可以给出答案，人仍要形成自己的看法。
summary.en: Dianne asks what teams should get in return for spending more tokens. She connects experimentation and evaluation design with a personal question about helping children develop independent judgment.

insights.title: 把实验当作产出
insights.detail: Token 用量能说明投入了多少。Dianne 更想看团队拿新模型做了哪些实验，因为实验结果才能决定下一步验证什么。
insights.detailEn: Token consumption measures an input. Dianne would rather set goals around the experiments that spending makes possible.

insights.title: PM 也需要亲自写评测
insights.detail: 用户体验取决于模型和外围应用怎样配合。PM 把真实使用中的好坏写成测试用例，才容易看清该改哪一层。
insights.detailEn: PMs can write evaluations for the whole user experience, where model behavior and the surrounding application meet.

insights.title: 独立判断需要练习
insights.detail: 谈到孩子时，她希望他们既好奇，又能形成和坚持自己的见解。她把这种能力看作未来工作中难以替代的一部分。
insights.detailEn: Penn wants her children to cultivate curiosity, persistence, and the confidence to form a judgment of their own.

related.reason: 进一步看怎样从真实失败样例写出 AI 产品评测。
related.reasonEn: How to turn real failure cases into useful AI evaluations.
